How to Make Pour-Over Coffee

Next: Next chapter, Previous: Previous chapter, Up: Index

Pour-over coffee is a simple, repeatable brewing method. You need hot water, ground beans and a cone filter.

Here is what you need: grinder, kettle, filter, and a little patience.

Step 1: Rinse the filter

Wet the paper filter with hot water to remove the papery taste. This also warms your dripper.

Step 2: Bloom

Add coffee, then pour twice the water weight. Wait 30 seconds, then watch the CO2 bloom.

Good coffee is a matter of balance, not magic.
